test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**accorded**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Accorded** means** to give or grant**.

 
 
• Example - ***Duke was accorded the highest honor***.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, **Women must be accorded equal rights and opportunities in all fields, regardless of their gender.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Taken** means** to take**.

 
 
• Example -*** Brian has taken the car for a spin***.
 
 
 
• **Accepted** means** to come to terms with or agree**.
 
 
• Example - ***The management agreed to the employee's demands.***
 
 
 
• **Satisfied with** means **happy**.
 
 
• Example - ***Tom seems very satisfied with his new car.***
